description: `items.merge` input: films (or shows) that are one work.

from.description: The films or shows that are the same work. Their files are fixed to belong to `into` (episodes keep their numbers); each goes once it's empty, and what people and agents set on it carries over.

into.description: The film or show to keep.

mode.description: Apply now, or leave for an Owner or Admin to review.

oneOf.description: Change it now (Owner or Admin; anyone else's edit is proposed).
Make a proposal: nothing changes until it's applied in the app or with `changes.apply`.

summary.description: What's being merged and why, for the person reviewing it.

title: MergeInput
